correctness.rationale: On any standard nonzero monomial Z_{i,δ}, the coordinate semigroup is exactly C[y_k:k≠i]⊗C[b_sj:s∈{0,1},j≠i]/I_2(B): every coordinate is a monomial in these generators, y exponent characters independent and kernel of Segre parameterization is prime 2-minors. The resulting chart is normal CM, dim 2n−1, singular exactly where B=0, yielding n disjoint Segre (P1)^{n−1} components; transverse multiplicity is n−1. The cone local class group is Z and canonical class maps to (n−3) times generator, so Gorenstein iff n=3 and non-Q-Gorenstein singularities for n≥4. Independent exponent-vector and lattice-rank verification checked all coordinates for n=3,4,5; infinite statement rests on the general semigroup isomorphism.
